title: Blue Watcher of the Pyramid
wikitext:
[[Image:BlueWatcherOfThePyramid.png|right|160px]]
'''Blue Watcher of the Pyramid''' is a [[unique item]].  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game.

==Card info==
'''Any Phase''': Lose 2 [[Stamina]] and discard Blue Watcher of the Pyramid to automatically succeed at a [[Combat check]] or a [[Fight check]] or [[Lore check]] made to close a [[gate]].  This cannot be used against an [[Ancient One]].

'''Price''': $4
